{{Quote|There was this trooper from the ''Executor'' that said there was some female Darktrooper designated HX-138. I thought he was just pulling our leg.|A stormtrooper, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtS" />}}
'''HX-138''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The only location I know coordinates to is a hold out camp of Stormtrooper 'Ims' at the Research and Prison Facility. Ground zero to the virus.''"<br />"''Ims?''"<br />"''Immunes. There is a small possibility of being naturally immune to the virus.|[[Trig Longo]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Trig|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], HX-138 was stationed at the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], along with fellow stromtroopers [[KD-121]] and [[GT-643]]. She used to wear a black [[Imperial Spec Ops Officer armor]] and was referred as a Darktrooper.<ref name="SWG:FtS" />

[[File:Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Camp Epsilon]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> HX-138, GT-643 and KD-121 were part of<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> a contingent of stormtroopers who appeared to be immunized to the virus,<ref name="SWG:StT" /> and commanded by HX-138. The stormtroopers survived the outbreak but were trapped in the Quarantine Zone like other survivors. The stormtroopers and the refugees created a makeshift camp, designated as [[Camp Epsilon]], in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> Those other survivors included the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]]<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref>, the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]].<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> In fact, Camp Epsilon was very unsafe since it was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, the place where lived the most dangerous undeads.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> However, the camp was established around a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], the last [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the area that was not destroyed during the outbreak. The ship was damaged and unable to fly but Nils Cridmeen and HX-138 expected to fix it in order to allow the survivors to escape the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:SP" />

A group of spacers visited Camp Epsilon during their journey in the Quarantine Zone. They assisted HX-138 and the stormtroopers in rescuing some survivors<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> and finding parts to fix the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The spacers later left Camp Epsilon to enter the Imperial Research and Prison Facility in order to recover a sample of the Blackwing virus.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> The spacers survived to their mission and finally came back to Camp Epsilon. In the meantime, Nils Cridmeen was able to fix the Lambda-class shuttle. The refugees of Camp Epsilon and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the repaired shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
HX-138 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> HX-138 was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>

HX-138's name was likely a reference to [[1138 (easter egg)|THX 1138]].
